caption: Figure 1: Overview of EBS Architecture. VD: Virtual Disk; LSBD: Log-Structured Block Device. GC: Garbage Collection.

templates.why_chosen: Three full-width tiers (Compute, Block, Persistence) are named in the left margin, each a nested box-in-box (VMs inside the Compute Server, GC/Snapshot Workers inside each Block Proxy), connected top-down by double-headed LSBD arrows.
templates.what_to_learn: Nest the repeated internal structure (VMs in the compute tier, GC/Snapshot workers in each block proxy) inside its tier's own box rather than flattening it, and name every tier once in a shared left margin; add one accent colour, since this figure's all-gray palette (a listed weakness) makes component roles hard to tell apart.
